subject: need to find an archived version of "aroma" which will work with the "kth" package

messages.author: d8e41d06b84600c6
messages.subject: need to find an archived version of "aroma" which will work with the "kth" package
parts:
Hi,

I'm trying to repeat a two-color array analysis done in 2008 which
used the "kth" package. kth depends on "aroma". However, "aroma" is
of course no longer available on CRAN (neither is kth). I was able to
locate kth at http://www.biotech.kth.se/molbio/microarray/R/bin/windows/contrib/.
I would like to find a version of "aroma" which will work with "kth".

thanks for any help,

Scott Ochsner
Baylor College of Medicine
Houston, Texas
